title: Harold Malmgren's deathbed account of Naval Intelligence

tellings.quote: naval intelligence are going to be around asking you questions about your study. They really get curious and if they talk to you for any length of time, they'll say, "Holy you really know a lot." They're going to offer you special access.

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, recounts what Harold Malmgren, a former presidential adviser, told him late in his life. According to Michels, Malmgren warned that people from naval intelligence, the US Navy's spy service, would come around asking about his research, and that once they saw how much he knew, they would offer him special access to secret information. If true, it would mean the Navy quietly recruits people who get too close to the subject.
